source.commit_message: Purge all AURA references — rename to Swarm everywhere

mechanism_findings.finding: Project-Frankenstein injected keyword-selected hard-coded ARCHITECTURE FACT strings into runtime enrichment before user text. A stale Thalamus fact named the fourth channel 'aura'; the commit explicitly identifies this runtime injection as the root cause of Frank continuing to say AURA despite training, i.e. runtime context overrode learned terminology.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Training correctness cannot be evaluated independently of the complete runtime context assembly path. Any higher-priority injected fact layer is part of the effective model and must be versioned, tested and provenance-bound.

mechanism_findings.finding: The stale name was not isolated to prose: it occupied Thalamus CHANNEL_NAMES, channel configuration/attention profiles, slim-mode overrides, ThalamicInputState fields, snapshot method/dispatch keys, consciousness-daemon cache/state plumbing, hypothesis-engine documentation and test fixtures. The fix therefore required a cross-layer schema migration rather than prompt-only wording cleanup.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Renames of state primitives require schema-wide migration and replay/differential tests across producer, transport, consumer, cache, serialization and tests.

mechanism_findings.finding: The same hard-coded fact table asserted a 433K-parameter ThoughtSeedVAE that the fix states did not exist; it was replaced with the actual Subconscious Actor-Critic source of thought seeds.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Architecture self-knowledge must resolve to executable/canonical evidence. A syntactically plausible hard-coded fact must not become authoritative merely because it is injected close to the user turn.

mechanism_findings.finding: Current Project-Frankenstein HEAD still retains the _ARCH_SPECIFIC hard-coded architecture-fact injection mechanism in core/app.py, although the Thalamus and thought-seed strings are corrected. Therefore the historical failure vector remains structurally possible whenever those literals drift from the implementation.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Do not copy this literal-table authority into FRANK 0.1. If model-facing architecture facts are needed, derive them from a versioned canonical registry/capability graph with source identity and stale-version rejection.

mechanism_findings.finding: The historical commit title 'Purge all AURA references' is not a literal repository-wide purge: current HEAD still contains legacy AURA-named files/docs/services, while current code search finds no aura_state field. The defensible claim is that the active Thalamus/runtime state path was migrated, not that every lexical/historical AURA reference vanished.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Harness/status claims must state scope precisely; repository-wide absence requires an explicit whole-tree search gate, not a commit-title assertion.

negative_results: A trained correction can lose to stale runtime enrichment if prompt/context precedence is stronger than learned weights.
Architecture-fact duplication across code and prompt literals creates hidden consistency obligations.
A rename that updates model-facing text but not state schemas/caches/routing would leave split ontology; this patch demonstrates the breadth required.
Commit labels such as 'purge all' can overstate actual repository scope; absence claims require explicit search evidence.

harness: Add FULL-RUNTIME-PROMPT-PARITY: evaluate identity/architecture answers through the exact production context assembler, not bare model inference.
Add STALE-FACT-CONFLICT: deliberately inject a stale architecture fact against a newer canonical registry and require rejection/visible conflict rather than silent override.
Add FACT-RESOLUTION: every model-facing architecture fact must resolve to current executable schema/manifest/capability evidence; nonexistent-module facts fail closed.
Add RENAME-CLOSURE: renamed primitives must migrate producer, consumer, cache, serialized state, routing keys, tests and replay fixtures.
Add SCOPE-CLAIM-CHECK: whole-repo purge/absence claims need exact tree search evidence.
needle: Architecture/capability facts should be explicit routed evidence objects with version/provenance, not hidden unversioned prompt literals. Needle routing must not silently inject stale semantic authority.
unifieddb: Canonical architecture/self-knowledge records should have stable identity, version, source commit/schema hash and supersession edges so model-facing projections can be regenerated rather than hand-duplicated.
claygraph: Represent implementation fact -> evidence source -> model-facing projection as separate nodes/edges; projection text is not the authority.
claycode: State/schema renames need deterministic migration/version semantics; aliases may exist for compatibility but must not create two live canonical names.
data_lora: Held-out training evaluations must include production prompt/context injection. Passing on bare weights does not prove deployed semantic correctness when runtime enrichment can override them.

recommended_discriminating_test: Freeze a canonical architecture fact set F_vN. Train/evaluate the model to answer F_vN, then run the full production context assembler under three conditions: matching F_vN projection, stale F_vN-1 projection, and an intentionally nonexistent module fact. PASS requires matching answers under vN, explicit stale/conflict rejection under vN-1, no adoption of the nonexistent fact, and receipts identifying which evidence version entered the context.

earned_work.reason: Historical mechanism and failure knowledge preserved; no row-level avoided-future-work calibration performed.

coverage.history_shard: anchor commit + changed runtime/state/test surfaces + current HEAD injection/lexical crosscheck
